verdict.rationale: Persona's docs say Reports can be set to run at regular intervals against an account, such as a monthly or yearly Watchlist Report. That is a genuine first-party recurring schedule, but it covers only one job type. Workflows are documented with triggers, yet no schedule or cron trigger is shown, so general recurring workflows are unproven. Missing for 10: schedule-based workflow triggers, arbitrary recurring jobs beyond reports, API/programmatic schedule management, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Reports can be configured to run in regular intervals against an account. For example, you can run a Watchlist Report against your accounts each month or once a year.
All workflows begin with a trigger, which initiates the workflow. Several trigger types exist
